label: Jugular Venous Oxygen Saturation
definition: Jugular venous oxygen saturation, an indicator of cerebral oxygen consumption.

label: Brain Monitoring
definition: A systematic approach to collect and analyze data related to brain function and health.

label: Outcome Data
definition: Data related to the results or consequences of medical treatment or interventions.

label: Arterial Oxygen Saturation
definition: Arterial oxygen saturation measured by pulse oximetry, indicating blood oxygenation levels.

label: Treatment Data
definition: Information regarding the medical interventions administered to patients.

label: Neurological Injury
definition: An injury that affects the nervous system, including the brain and spinal cord.

label: Transcranial Doppler
definition: Transcranial Doppler ultrasonography, used to assess cerebral blood flow velocity.

label: Clinical Research Form (CRF)
definition: A document used to collect data from participants in clinical trials, particularly regarding adverse events.

label: Trauma
definition: A physical injury or wound caused by external force or violence.

label: Injuries
definition: Physical harm or damage to the body, often resulting from accidents or trauma.

label: Brain Tissue Oxygen
definition: Partial pressure of brain tissue oxygen, measuring local cerebral oxygenation.

label: Substance Abuse
definition: The harmful or hazardous use of psychoactive substances, including alcohol and illicit drugs.

label: Monitoring Standards
definition: Agreed protocols and guidelines for the collection and analysis of monitoring data in clinical settings.

label: Coma
definition: A state of prolonged unconsciousness where a person cannot be awakened and fails to respond to stimuli.

label: Error
definition: A classification indicating a potential issue with a recorded value.

label: Traumatic Brain Injury
definition: A type of brain injury caused by an external force, often leading to significant morbidity and mortality.

label: Central Venous Pressure
definition: Central venous pressure, measuring the pressure in the thoracic vena cava near the right atrium.

label: Head Injury
definition: An injury to the skull or brain, which can have severe consequences for the victim and society.

label: Machine
definition: A device used in medical evaluations that incorporates sensors.

label: Mortality
definition: The cessation of all biological functions that sustain a living organism.

label: Admission Data
definition: Information gathered at the time of patient admission to a healthcare facility.

label: End-Tidal Carbon Dioxide
definition: End-tidal carbon dioxide concentration, reflecting ventilation adequacy.

label: Reading
definition: A measurement that refers to the parameter being observed and its value.

label: Provenance
definition: A description of the entities and processes involved in producing a resource.
